propositions: Multiple test scanners independently parse the same source trees (tests/ and src/rebar), causing redundant AST parsing that accounts for 75-80% of scan cost and dominates test gate duration.

A shared process-global memoized parse helper via functools.cache with resolved root paths deduplicates parsing across scanners within a single xdist worker, reducing subsequent scans from 6.64s→2.89s and 5.07s→1.91s in proof-of-concept.

Whole-tree AST scanners over committed trees are migrated to the shared helper while excluding scanners that also operate on synthetic/tmp_path roots where eager parsing may fail or path resolution errors may occur.

The parse contract preserves byte-identical results via strict UTF-8 decoding and filename metadata, making migration behavior-preserving across 38 test scanners across unit/store/commands/reconciler/contracts directories.
